# AI design · AI 设计

Designing AI products (interaction patterns, platform guidance), AI tools that generate interfaces and assets, and the agent-facing layer: skills, rule sets, formats such as DESIGN.md, and MCP servers that give agents design files and a browser. This field moves quickly: date what you take.

56 resources, plus 18 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `scripts/catalog.py find` searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## AI UX patterns and components · AI 交互模式与组件

Chat, copilot and agent interface patterns from shipped products, plus the component kits that implement them.

## AI product guidelines · AI 产品指引

Official and research-based guidance on trust, explainability, labelling AI output and UI inside chat hosts. Check the date on every page.

Prompt-to-UI and prompt-to-asset tools. Useful for fast variants and for seeing the current default look, which is also the look to diverge from.

## Agent-readable formats · 面向 agent 的格式

Files that describe a design system to an agent, such as DESIGN.md, and collections of them.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [DESIGN.md specification](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) | Google Labs' open format for describing a visual identity to coding agents in one Markdown file (YAML tokens plus prose), with a CLI that lints contrast and structure and diffs two versions | Write system/DESIGN.md in this shape, then run npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md (structured JSON findings, including WCAG contrast) and diff against the previous version; Stitch reads and writes the same file. | S | spec | static | free · Apache-2.0 (github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) | [Specification (docs/spec.md)](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md/blob/main/docs/spec.md); [Stitch docs page (JavaScript app)](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/design-md/specification) |
| [awesome-design-md](https://getdesign.md) | Collection of DESIGN.md files describing the visual systems of well-known products | Use as style-DNA study material, never as a licence to clone a brand | A | repo | static | free · MIT (github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md); brands belong to their owners |  |
| [Refero Styles](https://styles.refero.design) | Design systems extracted from 2,000+ real product sites (colours, type, spacing, components), each with a DESIGN.md | Use as style-DNA study material and to seed the structure of a DESIGN.md; never ship a clone of a brand. | A | archive | static | freemium |  |
| [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) | The convention of a /llms.txt Markdown index (and often llms-full.txt) that points agents at clean documentation; many design systems now ship one | Before scraping a design system's site, try <site>/llms.txt: Carbon, Ant Design, Atlassian, Cloudscape, TDesign and AntV serve one (checked 2026-09-27). Publish one for your own system's docs. | A | spec | static | free · Apache-2.0 |  |
| [AGENTS.md](https://agents.md) | The open Markdown convention for repository instructions to coding agents (a README for agents), now stewarded under the Linux Foundation | Put the project's design rules (tokens file, component library, forbidden patterns, how to run the visual checks) in AGENTS.md so any coding agent picks them up; Vercel's interface guidelines ship in this form. | A | spec | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io) | The open SKILL.md format this suite is written in: a folder with SKILL.md (name, description, instructions) plus optional scripts, references and templates | Check a skill's frontmatter and folder layout against the spec before publishing, so it installs in any compatible agent. | A | spec | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [GitHub](https://github.com/agentskills/agentskills) |
| [AI and design systems (home: reading)](https://bradfrost.com/blog/post/ai-and-design-systems/) | How design systems become the constraint layer for AI-generated UI | Argument for investing in tokens before generation | A | article | static | free |  |

| [shadcn/ui registry and MCP](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/mcp) | Lets agents browse and install components from shadcn-compatible registries | Run pnpm dlx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude (or cursor, vscode, codex) in the project, then ask the agent to list and add components from the configured registries instead of writing them from memory. | A | mcp | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Playwright MCP](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp) | Browser automation for agents through Playwright | Add it with npx @playwright/mcp@latest; it drives the page through accessibility snapshots, so use it for multi-viewport walkthroughs and flows, and a screenshot tool for visual judgement. | A | mcp | static | free · Apache-2.0 |  |
| [Storybook MCP](https://storybook.js.org/docs/ai/mcp/overview) | Storybook's official MCP addon: exposes the component manifest, docs and stories so agents reuse the project's real components instead of inventing new ones | Run npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp, start Storybook and point the agent at http://localhost:6006/mcp; ask it to query components before writing any new one. | A | mcp | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Mobbin MCP](https://mobbin.com/mcp) | Lets agents search Mobbin's 600,000+ real product screens and flows in natural language | Use in the research step to pull three shipped precedents for a screen before designing it. | A | mcp | static | paid · login |  |
| [Penpot (home: code)](https://penpot.app) | Open-source design tool built on SVG and CSS concepts, with tokens and an MCP server | Self-hostable design source of truth; agents connect through its official MCP server | A | tool | static | free · MPL-2.0 |  |
| [pen.dev (formerly Pencil) (home: code)](https://www.pen.dev) | Agent-native design canvas (desktop and IDE) whose .pen files are an open format kept in the repo, with MCP, WebMCP and CLI access | Keep .pen files next to the code so agents and people edit the same design; review agent edits like code | A | tool | static | free · login | [Docs (.pen format, CLI, design and code)](https://docs.pen.dev) |
| [Paper (home: code)](https://paper.design) | Design tool whose canvas is built on HTML and CSS, with an MCP server through which agents read and write frames | Use when designs should hand off as CSS; connect the MCP server so an agent can lay out frames or turn a selected frame into code | A | tool | static | freemium · login | [MCP server](https://paper.design/docs/mcp) |
| [TDesign (zh) (home: app-ui)](https://tdesign.tencent.com) | Tencent's system spanning web, mobile, mini-program and Flutter with shared design values | Pick when one product must ship across web, mobile, mini-program and Flutter; agents can read /llms.txt (design-guide index) and connect the official MCP server (npx -y tdesign-mcp-server@latest: component list, docs, DOM structure, changelog, icon search). | A | system | js | free · MIT | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://tdesign.tencent.com/llms.txt); [TDesign MCP server (source)](https://cnb.cool/tencent/tdesign/tdesign-mcp-server); [Components per stack (Vue 3, React, mini-program, mobile, Flutter)](https://tdesign.tencent.com/vue-next/overview) |
| [Google Stitch (home: ai-design-tools)](https://stitch.withgoogle.com) | Google Labs' AI UI designer: generates screens and variants from prompts, reads and writes DESIGN.md, and exposes projects to agents through an MCP server | Use for fast visual variants from a DESIGN.md, then take the chosen direction into code and critique it like any other draft; connect the MCP server to generate or edit screens from the agent. | A | generator | js | free · login | [Stitch via MCP (setup)](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup); [Stitch skills (GitHub)](https://github.com/google-labs-code/stitch-skills) |
| [Official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) | The protocol project's official registry of MCP servers, with a public JSON API | Search here for a vendor's official server before trusting a third-party listing; agents can query the API directly (for example ?search=figma returns com.figma.mcp/mcp and its remote URL). | A | api | js | free | API `https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search={query}` |
| [UX Patterns for Developers (home: app-ui)](https://uxpatterns.dev) | 90+ UI patterns, each documented with anatomy, best practices, accessibility and testing, framework-agnostic, with an MCP server and llms.txt for agents | Before building a pattern you have not specified (combobox, infinite scroll, date input), read its page or point the agent at /llms.txt or the MCP server. | A | pattern-library | blocked | free · MIT | [llms.txt](https://uxpatterns.dev/llms.txt) |
